brief_summary: Three-column glyph strip. Each column names one rattle source (wire-in-stem slop, stem-in-housing play, housing-to-plate/PCB movement), gives its sound in coral serif italic (rattle / tick or scrape / clunk), a one-line descriptor, a small mechanism glyph, and a vertical travel bar from top-out to bottom-out with coral shading where in the stroke the sound lands: both ends for rattle, a single point near bottom-out for tick, bottom-out only for clunk. Serif italic title 'where it sounds tells you which gap'.
